content: For patients receiving enteral or parenteral nutrition, insulin dosing must be tailored to the individual needs of the patient. A commonly used guideline is to administer 1 unit of insulin for every 10 to 15 grams of carbohydrates provided in the enteral or parenteral feeding regimen. It is essential to maintain consistent insulin dosing to effectively manage blood glucose levels, with adjustments made as necessary based on the specific nutritional composition of the feeding formula to achieve optimal glycemic control.
